## Overview

Mark a &lt;ng-template> inside your component as the overlay content.

Usage:
```html
<button qzOverlayTrigger [overlayTemplate]="tpl" placement="bottom-start">
  Open
</button>

<ng-template #tpl>
  <div class="my-dropdown">...</div>
</ng-template>
```

Or pass a TemplateRef programmatically via [overlayTemplate].

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzOverlay`
- **Source:** [packages/core/src/overlay/overlay-trigger.directive.ts:46](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/core/src/overlay/overlay-trigger.directive.ts#L46)
